title: Design: narrower than 1024 px the reports show the mobile filter row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 900 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the filter row.
  2. Look at the table.
  3. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices at the same width and look again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the native mobile filter row shows instead of the desktop chips.
  • Step 2: the table scrolls sideways; nothing else is laid out for small screens.
  • Step 3: the same: the mobile filter row and a table that scrolls sideways.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • Out of Scope: “A phone or tablet layout. Narrower than 1024 pixels, the reports show the native mobile filter row and the table scrolls sideways; nothing else is designed for small screens in this release.”
  • Form factor: “Form factor: Desktop only by rule: these are detailed reports.”
